subjects: Andy’s note: 2 weeks of Junior Royals left
preheader: Plus the last Junior Royals sessions before Christmas, our players’ big weekend and gift ideas from $38.50.
intro: Welcome to the first Royals Report. Every second Tuesday I’ll send you a short note on what’s happening across the Academy: how our players are going, what’s coming up, and the best of the wider Royals family.

It’s been a big fortnight. Our players had a big weekend of club cricket, our first touring group is back from the home of the Royals in India, and one of the Royals’ own teenagers rewrote the record books.

letterCta.text: Two weeks left before Christmas. Join now and keep your spot for the new year.

ps.text: P.S. Junior Royals payments pause over the Christmas break and you keep your spot. Last sessions: Monday 14 December at Mickleham, Wednesday 16 December at Cranbourne North.

items.title: Junior Royals
items.body: Mondays at Mickleham or Wednesdays at Cranbourne North: 5pm for ages 7 to 9, 6pm for ages 10 to 12. Join before the break: payments pause over Christmas and you keep your spot.

items.tag: One-to-one, or bring a training partner
items.title: Private Coaching
items.body: Train one-to-one with an Academy coach, or share the session with a training partner, at Cranbourne North, Hallam, Mickleham or Ravenhall.
items.alt: A coach working one-to-one with a batter

items.title: April 2027 India Tour
items.body: About ten days at the Rajasthan Royals High Performance Centre. Registering interest is free and commits you to nothing. We’ll send the dates and price to everyone registered.
items.alt: Players with Royals coaches at the High Performance Centre

items.title: Performance Squads
items.body: Season-long squads at Mickleham and Cranbourne North. Register now and we’ll tell you first when the next trial dates are set.

feature.title: 204 off 53. He’s 15.
feature.body: Rajasthan Royals teenager Vaibhav Sooryavanshi hit the fastest hundred (28 balls) and the fastest double hundred ever in one-day List A cricket, with a world-record 28 sixes, as India A beat the UAE in Doha.

players.title: A big weekend of club cricket

cards.title: Two unbeaten eighties and five wickets
cards.body: Siddhant Goel carried his bat for 86 not out and Dhruva Bezawada made 81 not out in Premier Under-18s. Jake Frederiksen took five wickets for 45 runs for Diamond Creek’s First XI.
cards.alt: Weekend Wrap, 20 to 22 November: our top performers in club cricket

story.title: Our first tour to the home of the Royals
story.body: In September our first touring group trained at the Rajasthan Royals High Performance Centre in Nagpur, coached by Faiz Fazal, Siddharth Trivedi and Sid Lahiri on turf nets and in centre-wicket sessions.
story.alt: Academy players warming up in front of the Rajasthan Royals High Performance Centre in Nagpur

tip.title: Training in the heat
tip.body: Melbourne summer cricket is hot. Drink before you feel thirsty: a few big mouthfuls before training, then small sips at every drinks break. Wear a cap, reapply sunscreen at the break, and pack a piece of fruit for after. Recovery starts the minute you walk off.
